newsitem.title: USA: Donnkenny buys Fashion Avenue Knitwear.
newsitem.headline: Donnkenny buys Fashion Avenue Knitwear.

text.p: Sportswear company Donnkenny, Inc. said Monday it agreed to buy Fashion Avenue Knitwear, a maker of women's and men's knits and sweaters.
Donnkenny said the acquisition is expected to add $40 million in annual sales volume during the 1997 fiscal year.
Based in Ridgewood, N.Y., Fashion Avenue Knitwear designs and manufactures ladies and men's knits and sweaters, primarily for the juniors market.

New York-based Donnkenny designs, manufactures, imports and markets a broad line of moderately priced women's sportswear. It also markets women's, men's and children's sportswear and has an intimate apparel line featuring various licensed cartoon characters.
Donnkenny's stock was off 37.5 cents at $17.50 in morning trading on Nasdaq.
